async src.routes.auth.signup(body: UserCreateSchema, bt: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))[source]¶

Register a new user.

A verification email is scheduled and the user’s password is hashed before the account is persisted.

Parameters:

  • body – Validated user registration data.

  • bt – FastAPI background task manager.

  • request – Current HTTP request.

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

Returns:

Newly created user.

Raises:

HTTPException – If an account with the same email already exists.

async src.routes.auth.update_avatar_user(file: UploadFile = File(PydanticUndefined), current_user: User = Depends(dependency=<bound method Auth.get_current_user of <src.services.auth.Auth object>>, use_cache=True, scope=None), db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None))[source]¶

Upload and update the authenticated user’s avatar.

The image is uploaded to Cloudinary and the cached authenticated user is invalidated after the avatar URL is updated.

Parameters:

  • file – Uploaded image file.

  • current_user – Currently authenticated user.

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

Returns:

Updated user.

Contacts routes¶

async src.routes.contacts.create_contact(contact_data: ContactCreateSchema, bt: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), current_user: User = Depends(dependency=<bound method Auth.get_current_user of <src.services.auth.Auth object>>, use_cache=True, scope=None)) → Contact[source]¶

Create a new contact for the authenticated user.

Phone numbers are checked for duplicates before creation. Related contact caches are invalidated and an email notification is scheduled.

Parameters:

  • contact_data – Validated contact creation data.

  • bt – FastAPI background task manager.

  • request – Current HTTP request.

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • current_user – Currently authenticated user.

Returns:

Newly created contact.

Raises:

HTTPException – If one of the phone numbers already exists.

Delete a contact belonging to the authenticated user.

Related Redis cache entries are invalidated after deletion.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • contact_id – Identifier of the contact to delete.

  • current_user – Currently authenticated user.

Returns:

None.

async src.routes.contacts.get_contacts(limit: int = Query(10), offset: int = Query(0), db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), current_user: User = Depends(dependency=<bound method Auth.get_current_user of <src.services.auth.Auth object>>, use_cache=True, scope=None)) → Sequence[Contact][source]¶

Return a paginated list of contacts for the authenticated user.

Results are cached in Redis for a short period.

Parameters:

  • offset – Number of contacts to skip.

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • current_user – Currently authenticated user.

Returns:

Sequence of contacts.

HTTPException – If contacts cannot be found.

Search routes¶

async src.routes.searchs.get_contacts_with_upcoming_birthdays(db: AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), current_user: User = Depends(dependency=<bound method Auth.get_current_user of <src.services.auth.Auth object>>, use_cache=True, scope=None), *, __fastapi_cache_request: Request, __fastapi_cache_response: Response) → Sequence[Contact][source]¶

Return contacts with birthdays occurring within the upcoming week.

The result is cached separately for each authenticated user.

Parameters:

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • current_user – Currently authenticated user.

Returns:

Sequence of contacts with upcoming birthdays.

async src.routes.searchs.search_contacts(query: ~typing.Annotated[str, Query(PydanticUndefined)], db: ~sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio.session.AsyncSession = Depends(dependency=<function get_db>, use_cache=True, scope=None), current_user: ~src.entity.models.User = Depends(dependency=<bound method Auth.get_current_user of <src.services.auth.Auth object>>, use_cache=True, scope=None), *, __fastapi_cache_request: ~starlette.requests.Request, __fastapi_cache_response: ~starlette.responses.Response) → Sequence[Contact][source]¶

Search the current user’s contacts.

Contacts can be matched by first name, last name, or email address. The result is cached separately for each authenticated user.

Parameters:

  • query – Search string.

  • db – Asynchronous database session.

  • current_user – Currently authenticated user.

Returns:

Sequence of matching contacts.
